mapper.select: INSERT INTO task (type, payload, priority, dedup_key) VALUES (#{type}, #{payload, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{priority, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.task.TaskPriorityTypeHandler}, #{dedupKey}) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) WHERE state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT id FROM task WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE task SET state = 'RUNNING', locked_by = #{workerId}, locked_at = now(), attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM task WHERE state = 'QUEUED' AND run_after <= now() AND type IN #{t} ORDER BY priority, run_after, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING *
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET state = 'DONE', finished = now(), locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE task SET last_error = #{error}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, state = CASE WHEN attempts < #{maxAttempts} THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE 'DEAD' END, finished = CASE WHEN attempts < #{maxAttempts} THEN NULL ELSE now() END, run_after = CASE WHEN attempts < #{maxAttempts} THEN now() + make_interval(secs => #{backoffSeconds} * power(2, attempts - 1)) ELSE run_after END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE task SET state = 'QUEUED', locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL WHERE state = 'RUNNING'
AND locked_at < now() - make_interval(secs => #{lockedLongerThanSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM task GROUP BY state
